document.title: [Bug]: V2 block verification (rejection_sample_method="block") reuses position-keyed uniforms across rounds, so sampled output is biased
document.body:
### Your current environment
Environment (from the run logs; collect_env.py was not captured on that machine) ```text vLLM 0.31.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130, Python 3.12 GPU: Tesla T4 (sm_75), driver 580.82.07 (Colab), V2 model runner Kernel-level check also run on main 1dfe9fbdae73 under TRITON_INTERPRET=1 (triton 3.8.0, torch 2.13.0+cpu) ```
### 🐛 Describe the bug With the V2 runner, `rejection_sample_method="block"` and temperature > 0, the sampled output does not follow the target model's distribution. Standard verification on the same setup is fine. The acceptance uniform is `tl_rand32(seed, pos)` with one seed per request and the absolute position. In block mode every draft row reads its uniform, including rows after the accepted length. Those uniforms have been conditioned on that round's decision, and the next round verifies the same positions again with the same uniforms. A small case: the target is p = (1/2, 1/2) at every position, the drafter always proposes token 0, and gamma = 2. The third generated token is 0 with probability 5/12 instead of 1/2. The script below calls the V2 `rejection_sample` round by round with the inputs the model runner builds (rows `[last committed, d_1, d_2]` at positions `[L-1, L, L+1]`), so no model is needed: ```python import argparse import torch from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.rejection_sampler_utils import rejection_sample def run(block, fresh_seed, n_req, n_tok=6, gamma=2, p0=0.5, base_seed=12345, device="cuda"): logp = torch.log(torch.tensor([p0, 1 - p0], dtype=torch.float32)) g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(base_seed) out = [[int(torch.rand((), generator=g) >= p0)] for _ in range(n_req)] # prefill token seeds = torch.randint(0, 2**31 - 1, (n_req,), generator=g, dtype=torch.int64) rnd = 0 while True: active = [r for r in range(n_req) if len(out[r]) < n_tok] if not active: break rows, n = gamma + 1, len(active) L = torch.tensor([1 + len(out[r]) for r in active]) # prompt length 1 target_logits = logp.repeat(n * rows, 1).contiguous() draft_sampled = torch.zeros(n * rows, dtype=torch.int64) # drafts are always 0 pos = torch.zeros(n * rows, dtype=torch.int64) for k, r in enumerate(active): draft_sampled[k * rows] = out[r][-1] pos[k * rows:(k + 1) * rows] = torch.arange(L[k] - 1, L[k] - 1 + rows) cu = torch.arange(0, (n + 1) * rows, rows, dtype=torch.int32) idx_mapping = torch.arange(n, dtype=torch.int32) expanded_idx = idx_mapping.repeat_interleave(rows) expanded_local = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32).repeat(n) temperature = torch.ones(n, dtype=torch.float32) seed = seeds[active].clone() if fresh_seed: seed = (seed * 1000003 + 7919 * (rnd + 1)) % (2**31 - 1) args = [t.to(device) for t in (target_logits,)] + [None] + [ t.to(device) for t in (draft_sampled, cu, pos, idx_mapping, expanded_idx, expanded_local, temperature, seed)] sampled, num_sampled = rejection_sample(*args, gamma, use_block_verification=block) sampled, num_sampled = sampled.cpu(), num_sampled.cpu() for k, r in enumerate(active): out[r].extend(int(t) for t in sampled[k, : int(num_sampled[k])]) rnd += 1 return [sum(o[j] == 0 for o in out) / n_req for j in range(n_tok)] def main(): ap = argparse.ArgumentParser() ap.add_argument("--device", default="cuda") ap.add_argument("--n-req", type=int, default=100000) a = ap.parse_args() for block, fresh in [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True)]: m = run(block, fresh, a.n_req, device=a.device) name = f"{'block' if block else 'standard'}, {'fresh' if fresh else 'fixed'} seed" print(f"{name:22s} P(token j = 0), j = 0..5:", " ".join(f"{x:.4f}" for x in m)) print("exact: 0.5 at every j") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ``` On a T4 with 10^6 requests I get: ```text standard, fixed seed P(token j = 0), j = 0..5: 0.5012 0.5000 0.5001 0.4999 0.4994 0.5005 block, fixed seed P(token j = 0), j = 0..5: 0.5012 0.5003 0.4167 0.4862 0.4694 0.4661 block, fresh seed P(token j = 0), j = 0..5: 0.5012 0.5006 0.5005 0.4989 0.5008 0.4998 exact: 0.5 at every j ``` "fixed seed" is what the runner does (one seed per request). Changing only the seed every round removes the bias, so the cause is the reuse of the position-keyed uniforms. Token 0 is the prefill token, which doesn't go through verification. On main 1dfe9fbdae73 under the Triton interpreter (20000 requests) I get the same pattern: .506 .498 .415 .486 .461 .466, which is 24σ off at the third token. End to end it shows up the same way. With a tiny context-free model (p = (1/2, 1/2)), a draft model that always proposes the same token, gamma = 2 and 10000 samples on the T4, block verification rejects the correct output law (chi-square 3152, df 64, p ≈ 0) and fits the law the kernel above predicts (p = .48), while standard verification on the same models fits the correct law (p = .87). With probabilistic drafts (p = (.3, .7), q = (.7, .3)) block mode gives P(third token = a) = .3509 instead of .30. With the same kernel and freshly drawn drafts it is .3003 there, so in that case the extra bias comes from the draft Gumbel noise, which is keyed the same way by (seed, position). Code, at f26d9f432ced (byte-identical to v0.31.0 for the lines below): - one seed per request: [rejection_sampler_utils.py#L547](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f26d9f432ced7b1087d02d29bffed2249df1a18e/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/rejection_sampler_utils.py#L547) - uniform from (seed, position): [#L567-L569](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f26d9f432ced7b1087d02d29bffed2249df1a18e/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/rejection_sampler_utils.py#L567-L569) - block mode reads it on every row and keeps verifying past a failed row: [#L595-L627](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f26d9f432ced7b1087d02d29bffed2249df1a18e/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/rejection_sampler_utils.py#L595-L627) - draft noise from (seed, position + constant salt): [gumbel.py#L192-L193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f26d9f432ced7b1087d02d29bffed2249df1a18e/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/gumbel.py#L192-L193), called from [speculator.py#L439-L449](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/f26d9f432ced7b1087d02d29bffed2249df1a18e/vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/speculator.py#L439-L449) Standard verification stops reading uniforms at the first rejection, so a uniform it has read is never read again for a new decision. That is why only block mode is affected. Related: #47386 (closed) noted in its description that re-proposals at the same position reuse that position's draft key across steps, and #54282 decoupled the draft and target noise within a round. Neither covers the acceptance uniform in block mode. Suggested fix: it might be enough to mix something that changes every verification step into the uniform's offset (for example a per-request step counter), and the same for the draft noise. In the script, a fresh seed per round is exact. --- AI-assisted: found, reproduced and written up with Claude.
